svg.title: The Adjustment Ladder
svg.desc: An adjustment ladder taken one step at a time, moving on only if the earlier step doesn't stop the problem: fix a one-off in the chat, update the template, instructions or knowledge for a recurring issue, change the model, effort or feature if quality still falls short, and escalate to Architects or Developers when configuration can't solve it; or remove Claude from a step the results show it makes worse.
svg.text: Start at the bottom; climb only when the step below doesn't stop the problem.
Needs an integration or custom build
Change the model, effort or feature
Update the template, instructions or knowledge
START HERE, CLIMB ONLY IF THE LOWER STEP DOESN'T STOP IT
When results show the step is slower or worse
